decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects, removal spells, and token generation to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Avenging Hunter and Ichor Wellspring, while generating tokens with Khalni Garden and Thorn of the Black Rose, the deck can maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent. The addition of cards like Crypt Rats and Defile also helps in controlling the opponent's creatures, while cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering provide additional value through sacrificing. Overall, this Golgari Garden deck aims to grind out the opponent and win through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with cheap artifact creatures and utilizing cards like Thoughtcast to draw additional cards. By playing cards like All That Glitters and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to pump up its creatures and deal damage quickly, overwhelming the opponent with its aggressive strategy. The key strategy is to get out multiple artifact creatures early on to take advantage of cards like Springleaf Drum and Glint Hawk to generate additional value and keep up the pressure on the opponent.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on maintaining board control and disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage engines. By using efficient creatures like Lórien Revealed and Ninja of the Deep Hours, along with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Chainer's Edict, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of card draw and filtering spells to help find key cards and maintain a steady stream of threats and answers.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl, while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Thermokarst and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss. Once enough mana has been accumulated, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Generous Ent, Annoyed Altisaur, and Avenging Hunter. Additionally, the inclusion of Skred provides removal for opposing threats, and Llanowar Visionary helps to draw more cards and keep the aggression going.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and efficient creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With aggressive creatures like Kor Skyfisher and Seeker of the Way combined with removal spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Glint Hawk and Thraben Inspector provide card advantage and help maintain tempo. The deck also includes some disruptive elements like Journey to Nowhere and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main strategy of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and efficient creatures to outvalue and outlast opponents. By disrupting their opponent's game plan with counter spells and removal, while generating card advantage with cards like Augur of Bolas and Ninja of the Deep Hours, this deck aims to establish a strong board presence and dominate the late game. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw spells like Preordain and Brainstorm allows for consistent card selection and manipulation to ensure the deck runs smoothly and efficiently.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. Using cheap creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Goblin Blast-Runner, along with efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the goal is to deal as much damage as possible in the early turns of the game. Synergies like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Tomb Raider help to maintain board presence and continue putting pressure on the opponent. The overall strategy is to be fast and relentless, finishing off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to gain control over the game by utilizing the Urzatron lands to generate massive amounts of mana and cast powerful spells like Mulldrifter and Mnemonic Wall. The deck also focuses on card advantage and disruption with cards like Mystical Teachings and Prohibit. Additionally, it includes key interaction pieces such as Ghostly Flicker and Ephemerate to create value and outmaneuver the opponent. The inclusion of Moment's Peace and Weather the Storm helps the deck survive aggressive strategies, while Bojuka Bog and Pulse of Murasa provide graveyard hate and recursion options.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly flood the board with cheap artifact creatures and utilize affinity mechanics to reduce their costs. By combining creatures like Frogmite, Myr Enforcer, and Gingerbrute with powerful enchantments like All That Glitters, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of attacks. Metallic Rebuke provides some control and protection, while cards like Thoughtcast and Moon-Circuit Hacker help to dig for additional threats. With efficient mana production from Springleaf Drum and artifact lands, this deck can hit hard and fast in Pauper 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with artifact creatures and boosting them with equipment to deal massive damage to the opponent. It utilizes low-cost artifacts and mana acceleration to efficiently deploy threats, while also providing removal and card draw to maintain pressure on the opponent. By combining aggressive creatures with powerful buffs, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game and secure a fast victory.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By efficiently using mana and dealing direct damage, this deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can establish their own board presence. The synergy between cheap creatures, burn spells, and artifact support allows the deck to apply constant pressure and close out games in a swift manner. Utilizing the aggression and speed of red spells and creatures, this deck aims to secure victory through fast and relentless attacks.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Goblin Blast-Runner and Goblin Tomb Raider, while dealing direct damage with spells like Chain Lightning and Galvanic Blast. The deck also includes cards like Implement of Combustion and Seal of Fire to maintain pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards that can deal damage efficiently and quickly, the deck aims to defeat the opponent before they can set up their own game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game using counterspells and removal while generating value by repeatedly flickering powerful creatures like Mulldrifter with Ephemerate. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base with Cleansing Wildfire and utilize spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt for additional removal. It includes a small package of cantrips for card selection and mana fixing, as well as Archaeomancer to recur key instants and sorceries. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient control and card advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly playing out cheap artifact creatures and utilizing cards like Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute to draw cards and create value. With cards like Myr Enforcer and Reckoner's Bargain, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a high density of threats. The inclusion of Metallic Rebuke and Candy Trail allows for interaction and buffing of the team, while cards like Krark-Clan Shaman provide additional removal options. The mana base is designed to support the artifact theme, with a mix of artifact lands and regular lands to ensure smooth gameplay.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Bushwhacker to create a wide board presence, combined with efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent quickly. The inclusion of cards like Experimental Synthesizer and Voldaren Epicure provide additional threats and versatility, while cards like Chain Lightning and Fireblast help to close out the game. Overall, this deck is built to be fast, efficient, and relentless.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent by playing low-cost creatures and aggressive spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Thraben Inspector and Glint Hawk, along with versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, it aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes artifacts like Wedding Invitation and Experimental Synthesizer to provide additional value and resilience. With a mix of aggressive creatures and burn spells, this Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.
